news.title: College of Arts and Sciences Recognizes Faculty and Staff Excellence
Student Health's 'Billiken Nurse' Named Outstanding Nursing Professional
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University Student Health Center nurse Elise Molner brings the Jesuit value of cura personalis to student care on campus.

news.title: SLU Celebrates Class of 2026 at Commencement
news.summary_en: Filmmaker James Gunn urged the new graduates to embrace challenges during his remarks at Saint Louis University's spring commencement ceremony. In front of a packed crowd at Chaifetz Arena on Saturday, May 16, Gunn shared insights from his time at SLU and beyond.
